description: A small-molecule compound decreases a human gene’s expression in a statistically significant consensus differential-expression profile from LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map experiments. The edge points from the applied compound to the responding gene.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the compound–gene pair; negative values indicate decreased expression.

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each compound and target-gene tier; retained pairs pass α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING genes here are well-inferred, non-landmark genes.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures combined into the compound’s consensus profile; indicates supporting evidence.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the compound perturbation evidence.
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Small-molecule treatments (trt_cp) from GEO series GSE92742 (Phase I) and GSE70138 (Phase II), covering directly measured landmark genes and well-inferred non-landmark BING genes. Poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Only compounds and target genes represented in SPOKE are included; compounds lacking chemical identifiers and GSE70138-only compounds are excluded. No touchstone restriction is applied.
source_contributions.description: Signatures across cell lines, doses, times, and compound preparations are pooled into one compound consensus profile across both GEO series using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is evaluated separately for landmark and non-landmark BING targets. All significant landmark targets are retained; non-landmark BING targets are limited to the top 1,000 per compound by significance. Down-regulation edges have negative consensus z-scores.
